[[syntax trees at end of                     typer]] // MethodParameters.scala
package lexicalclosure {
  final lazy module val MethodParameters: lexicalclosure.MethodParameters =
    new lexicalclosure.MethodParameters()
  final module class MethodParameters() extends Object() {
    this: lexicalclosure.MethodParameters.type =>
    def addBy(delta: Int): Int => Int = (x: Int) =>
      {
        x + delta
      }
    def addBoth(first: Int, second: Int): Int => Int = (x: Int) =>
      {
        x + first + second + first
      }
    def shadow(delta: Int): Int => Int = (delta: Int) =>
      {
        delta
      }
    def byName(delta: => Int): Int => Int = (x: Int) =>
      {
        x + delta
      }
  }
}
